text: February 10, 1967, 1122 Erie County Sheriff's Department, Sandusky, Ohio,
with Constable Gary Butler, who earlier this morning sighted a UFO
over the NASA installation outside of town.
Yes, this is Rick Hilberg of Cleveland and Earl Neff of Cleveland interviewing from NICAP.
Could you just briefly tell us, run through the sighting,
and tell us what you saw on the approximate times
and any comments you might have or elaborations?
Well, this officer, while on patrol,
in the earlier part of Friday morning,
was going down one of our side roads, Shank Road,
which runs parallel with NESA, the local NASA establishment.
I was going on the east, from the east to west direction,
and making my turn onto the main road when I observed a bluish, bright-colored disc object
in a southwestern direction of the county.
I observed this object for approximately five minutes
before relaying the message to the Sheriff's Department
to make sure that what I did see was a true thing.
